subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature now, folded into the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md file editor, or deferred to plugin-contributed Control UI surfaces?
rationale: The request changes persistent context and sensitive user data behavior, while current main only supports raw allowlisted file editing and generic plugin tab projection that do not settle storage, freshness, authorization, or injection semantics.

options.title: Keep Canonical Pinned-Facts Design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, freshness labels, diff-preview, security, and injection tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Memory Panel
options.body: Treat the first version as part of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md memory panel if maintainers want raw memory editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer To Plugin UI Seam
options.body: Wait for the Control UI plugin contribution direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed instead of bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Pinned-Facts Design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, freshness labels, diff-preview, security, and injection tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses gateway file APIs, workspace/context injection, root memory policy, and plugin-vs-core product direction where the history points most strongly to steipete.
